item.title: 5.2.5-beta.2
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.2.5 Beta 2 - A New Color Picker & Drops That Land! 🎨📥

🆕 New In Beta 2

  • A new color picker: Every color setting opens a small picker right next to it instead of the macOS Colors window, with a palette, your recent colors, a Custom tab, a hex field and an eyedropper!
  • Widget colors: The Battery, Bluetooth and Clock widgets use the new picker too. Your saved colors stay the same!
  • Drop files on your dock apps: Drag a file from the Shelf or File Shelf panel, the Screenshots gallery or the Trash popover onto an app in a dock and it opens in that app, instead of landing on the Desktop!
  • File Shelf shows the real file: Files dropped on a File Shelf tile show their real name instead of a "Missing" card!
  • Drag widgets from the Widgets Library: Dropping a widget card from the Manager onto a dock adds it there!
  • No duplicate Shelf items: Dropping a Shelf item back onto its own Shelf is refused. Dropping it on the other Shelf adds it once!
  • Deleted apps leave the Live Dock: Apps you deleted no longer show up in a Live Dock as blank white icons. Thanks to Brandon for the report!

Known issue: with a File Shelf set to Remove after drag out, pressing Escape during a drag still removes the item.

🆕 New in 5.2.5

  • Notch dock backgrounds: Style → Background lets a notch dock be Black, any Color, Blur or Liquid Glass (still marked Beta on macOS 27). Thanks to David and Akiva for asking!
  • Hide docks from screen sharing: Settings → Behavior → Privacy keeps your docks out of Zoom, Meet and Teams shares, recordings and screenshots, while they stay on your screen!
  • One shortcut for several docks: Give docks the same Show/Hide shortcut and one press shows or hides them all together!
  • Label widget: A free widget that names a group of icons with a title, an optional second line and a length you choose, with vertical text for side docks!
  • Tint icons: Style → Icons → Tint icons colors every app, file and folder icon in a dock in one color!
  • Always show item names: Style → Size & Spacing shows every item's name without hovering!
  • Hide a dock item for a while: Click the eye button in Manager → Items to hide an item without removing it. It comes back in the same place!
  • One setting for every folder: Settings → Behavior → Clicking a folder picks Browse beside dock or Open in Finder for all folders at once!
  • App Stack single click: A new App Stack setting opens apps and folders with one click!
  • Shelf after dragging out: Shelf and Shelf (Cloud) can keep an item or remove it once you drop it somewhere else!

🚀 Improved in 5.2.5

  • Safer Move to Trash: In App Stacks and the folder browser it sits alone at the bottom, always asks first, and can be hidden in Settings → Behavior!
  • Folder browser closes like the macOS Dock: A click in another app, on the desktop or in the menu bar closes it!
  • The same folder twice: Add a folder again so one copy opens in Finder and the other browses beside the dock!
  • Manager window always fits: Its content no longer gets cut off or pushed under the title bar!
  • macOS 27 permission name: ExtraDock uses the new "Device Control and Data Access" name on macOS 27!

✅ What to test

  • Drag a file from Finder onto a File Shelf tile: it shows the real name.
  • Drag a file from the Shelf or File Shelf panel, the Screenshots gallery or the Trash onto an app in a dock: it opens in that app.
  • Drop a Shelf item back on its own Shelf: it slides back with no duplicate.
  • After any drag, click the empty part of a dock: the click goes to the window below.
  • Drag a widget from the Widgets Library onto a dock, and try a few colors with the new color picker.
  • Beta 1 features: hide docks from screen sharing, a shared Show/Hide shortcut, notch backgrounds, the item eye button, Clicking a folder, the Label widget, Tint icons and Always show item names.

This is a beta build. Thank you for testing! Please send anything that looks off, with Export Logs, to support@appitstudio.com.

ExtraDock 5.2.4 - Edge Peek, Smarter Menus & Easy App Stacks! 🫣📌✨

✨ What's New

  • Show at screen edge while hidden: A new per-dock option in Manager → your dock → Behavior. When Hide on Fullscreen or Hide on Window Hover has hidden a dock pinned to a screen edge, rest the pointer on that edge to bring it back. It hides again when you move away. Thanks to Radek for the idea!
  • App Stacks from the right-click menu: Right-click an app, folder or file and choose "New App Stack with" or "Add to App Stack"!
  • Timer presets: Pick 5, 10, 15, 25 or 60 minutes, or choose Custom and type the minutes. Saved timers keep their exact time!

🚀 Improvements

  • Menus beside the item: Right-click and Control-click menus open centred beside the item, like the macOS Dock, and never cover the dock!
  • Clearer Reserve Dock Space: The dock editor tells you when Reserve Dock Space is off in Settings and lets you turn it on right there!
  • Smoother first hover: The first item name after launch no longer stutters!
  • Manage Devices: License keys get a Manage Devices… button that opens your licenses page in Appit Services!
  • AI assistant changes are kept: Saving an open settings sheet no longer undoes a change an AI assistant or a dock menu made meanwhile!
  • No error-reporting library: ExtraDock no longer includes one (it never sent anything), and the Privacy section in Settings → General is gone!
  • Better diagnostics: Export Logs now includes widget log lines, and Export All Dock Diagnostics lists other apps' windows that a dock overlaps!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Visibility settings are back: Manager → your dock → Behavior shows Visibility again, with Show on (All Spaces, Active Space, Pinned) and Hide when a fullscreen app is active, so you can keep a dock showing over fullscreen apps!
  • Hide Dock really hides the dock: Hiding a dock from the menu bar, its right-click menu or your shortcut now fully removes it from the screen, so it no longer sits invisibly over other windows (like the App Store's Touch ID purchase sheet)!
  • Two copies of one app stay apart: Apps that install each yearly version side by side (like Photoshop 2025 and 2026) are now separate in your dock. Only the running copy shows a dot, and clicking a copy opens or brings forward that copy, never the other one!
  • No freeze on Automation permission checks: When macOS stops answering whether ExtraDock may control Finder, ExtraDock no longer freezes. It waits a few seconds at most and the Trash keeps its last count!
  • The Shelf stays a shelf: After you add files it shows a full tray with a count badge instead of file icons!
  • Focus filters remember your docks: Docks to Show and Docks to Hide now keep your choice on macOS 26.5. Filters made with an older version need their docks picked again once.

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
